item.title: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
item.description: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

item.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
item.description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.

item.title: Greetings from a Berlin square, where an artist's statue watches over children at play
item.description: Children frolic around the ever-watchful and calm Käthe Kollwitz cast in bronze, in a square named after the German artist, whose work often depicted children in the wake of World War I.

item.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
item.description: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

item.title: They tried to torture him into leaving Iraq. He refused to abandon the nature he protects
item.description: Iran-backed militias kidnapped and tortured him, but Jassim al-Asadi is still on a mission to save Iraq's marshes, and a way of life stretching back to the dawn of history.

item.title: China and the U.S. are the world's biggest polluters. And the U.S. is falling behind
item.description: The two largest emitters of greenhouse gases are China and the United States. Now, the countries' stories are diverging: many Chinese provinces are reducing coal use, while the U.S. is falling behind on climate technologies.

item.title: Putin to meet with Trump and Xi after Ukrainian attack on Russian bridge
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin will meet Thursday with President Trump and Chinese President Xi, escaping the aftermath of a Ukrainian attack that partially collapsed a prized bridge.
